rows.pred:
SELECT c.name AS client_name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id
WHERE c.region = '서울'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
FROM companyx.sales
WHERE quarter = '2025-Q3'

SELECT AVG(s.amount) AS avg_monthly_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'
SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.status = 'in_progress' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT st.id, st.title, st.description, st.priority, c.name AS client_name, p.name AS product_name, e.name AS assignee_name FROM companyx.support_tickets st JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id JOIN companyx.products p ON st.product_id = p.id JOIN companyx.employees e ON st.assignee_id = e.id WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status IN ('open', 'in_progress')

SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_contract_amount
FROM companyx.products p
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE c.region = '부산' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2025

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'security' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'cloud' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) THEN '보안'
    ELSE '클라우드'
  END AS category,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'security' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS security_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'cloud' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_sales
FROM 
  companyx.sales s
JOIN 
  companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
JOIN 
  companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE 
  c.region = '대전' 
  AND s.sale_date >= '2025-01-01' 
  AND s.sale_date < '2026-01-01'
SELECT (SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D1') - (SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D2') AS price_difference
SELECT version, release_date FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-C4'
SELECT contact_name, contact_email FROM companyx.clients WHERE name = 'Client-N'
SELECT name, hire_date FROM companyx.employees WHERE hire_date BETWEEN '2024-07-01' AND '2024-07-31'

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
WHERE e.salary BETWEEN 4000 AND 5000 AND e.is_active = true

SELECT st.title, st.created_at, c.name AS client_name
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id
WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status = 'open'

SELECT 
  companyx.support_tickets.id, 
  companyx.support_tickets.title, 
  companyx.support_tickets.created_at, 
  companyx.support_tickets.resolved_at
FROM 
  companyx.support_tickets
JOIN 
  companyx.clients ON companyx.support_tickets.client_id = companyx.clients.id
WHERE 
  companyx.clients.name = 'Client-X' 
  AND companyx.support_tickets.title LIKE '%장애%'

SELECT st.title, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) / 3600 AS hours_taken
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
WHERE st.status = 'resolved' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM st.resolved_at) = 2025
ORDER BY hours_taken DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name AS client_name, ct.end_date
FROM companyx.contracts ct
JOIN companyx.clients c ON ct.client_id = c.id
WHERE ct.end_date >= '2026-10-01' AND ct.end_date < '2026-11-01' AND ct.status = 'active'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, c.amount, c.start_date, c.end_date
FROM companyx.contracts c
JOIN companyx.products p ON c.product_id = p.id
JOIN companyx.clients cl ON c.client_id = cl.id
WHERE cl.name = 'Client-B' AND c.contract_type = 'subscription'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, p.budget, p.start_date
FROM companyx.projects p
JOIN companyx.clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Client-E' AND p.name = 'Client-E 로그 분석 시스템'
SELECT name FROM companyx.projects WHERE status = 'on_hold' AND end_date IS NULL

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.region
FROM companyx.clients c
WHERE c.industry = '의료/바이오'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.registered_at
FROM companyx.clients c
ORDER BY c.registered_at ASC
LIMIT 5
SELECT T1.sale_date, T1.amount FROM companyx.sales AS T1 JOIN companyx.products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Product-S2' AND T1.quarter = '2025-Q1'
SELECT e.name AS employee_name, e.salary, e.hire_date FROM companyx.employees e WHERE e.name = '김준혁'

SELECT 
  contract_type, 
  COUNT(*) AS cancelled_contracts
FROM 
  companyx.contracts
WHERE 
  start_date >= '2025-01-01' 
  AND status = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY 
  contract_type

SELECT CASE WHEN quarter IN ('2026-Q1', '2026-Q2') THEN '상반기' ELSE '하반기' END AS half_year, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE c.region = '서울' AND s.quarter IN ('2026-Q1', '2026-Q2')
GROUP BY half_year
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
